visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand, partially visible at the edges, holds a circular, golden-orange sweet potato donut topped with large almond and walnut pieces against a neutral studio background. The donut has a textured, coarse surface suggesting the presence of oats mixed with mashed sweet potato. White subtitles and a small brand logo appear at the top center of the frame. (2) In a clear glass bowl on a wooden tabletop, a hand in a transparent plastic glove uses a metal masher to press cooked orange sweet potato into a pulp. Raw rolled oats are then poured from a separate small glass bowl into the mashed sweet potato mixture while text overlays provide measurements. (3) The gloved hand vigorously kneads and mixes the orange sweet potato mash and white oats together until a uniform, thick dough is formed. The person then takes a portion of the dough, rolls it into a ball between their palms, and uses a finger to create a hole in the center, forming a ring. (4) Four donut-shaped dough rings are arranged on white parchment paper. A hand uses a yellow silicone brush to coat the top of each ring with a yellow egg wash. Subsequently, the hand carefully places several pieces of broken walnuts and whole almonds onto the sticky surface of the donuts. (5) The baking tray is slid into a clean, lighted oven. After baking, a close-up shows the finished donuts which have turned a deeper golden-brown color with a slightly crisp texture. A hand holds one up to the camera to showcase the final result, including the roasted nuts and the soft interior.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic and rhythmic electronic pop track begins with bright synthesizers and a strong 4/4 beat. A male narrator with a clear, enthusiastic voice introduces the 'Sweet Potato Oat Donut' recipe, speaking with high positive valence and moderate conversational intensity. (2) Rhythmic metallic clicking sounds are heard as the masher hits the glass bowl repeatedly. The narrator explains the first step of crushing cooked sweet potato while hot, maintaining a friendly tone with consistent volume and professional broadcasting clarity. (3) A distinct rustling sound of dry oats being poured occurs, followed by the soft squishing and rustling acoustic texture of plastic gloves mixing the damp dough. The narrator suggests grinding oats for a different texture, with the BGM remaining steady in the background. (4) Soft percussive thuds are audible as the shaped dough is placed onto the tray. A faint brushing sound accompanies the narrator mentioning the egg wash. This is followed by the sharp, irregular clicks of nuts being placed on top of the dough rings. (5) A heavy metallic thud and latching click signal the closing of the oven door. The narrator specifies the baking temperature and duration with a slightly higher pitch for emphasis. The upbeat BGM continues until the end, describing the final nutty aroma and bread-like texture.
